scientific_integrity: Proofs and counts are supplied without claims of independent certification. Public paper identities and first-public dates are cited; no authorship or independent validation is attributed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results concern rook graphs only. Finite computation cross-checks, but does not prove, the general formula. Unindexed and differently phrased prior work remains a possible priority risk.
title: Open-independent locating codes of rook graphs: a sharp modulo-three census
